what: A dark panel covers the Hero (a white film under the panel shows only inside the star hole), and four rings spin on the panel at 20s·15s·6s·3s (thin lines that fade to the background color over 288° counterclockwise from the head dot). The white film inside the star hole lifts after .5s over .4s and rests .2s. Then the star-shaped hole punched at the lower right of the ring circle (diameter min(90vh,90vw)) grows from circle diameter × .1102 to 20k px over 1s power4.in, revealing the page as if it bursts out of the star hole (fx:open → fx:done at the end)

options.veil: Wait before the white veil lifts (s), default .5
options.veil-dur: Duration (s) for the white curtain to lift, default .4 — at 0 there is no curtain, it goes straight in
options.gap: Pause (s) after the curtain lifts before the hole grows, default .2
options.dur: Time for all holes to open (sec), default 1 — 0 means immediate
options.x: Hole center — from the circle’s center to the right by circle diameter × (.5 − x), default .1135
options.y: Hole center — from the circle center downward by circle diameter × (.5 − y), default .1786
options.s: Initial hole size = Circle diameter × s, default .1102
options.rings: Number of rings 0~4, default 4 — 0 shows the plate only, with no rings
options.once: Given a name, it opens once per session and from then on only retracts in .4s
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Optional image for the panel center — instead of the ring or together with it, sized to the circle via --fx-c
options.fx:open·fx:done: Event bubbling up from the veil element — the text rise is handled in fx:open

use: (very end of body)

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .vp-intro (first-visit star-hole intro) — original intro__overlay-first star mask-size 1s power4.in 20k px, white intro__overlay-bg .4s (delay .5), circle-line01~04 20·15·6·3s

note: The overlay is two CSS mask layers (panel − star), so the ring over the panel is also cut out — same as the original. Scrolling is not blocked (the original does not block it either)
